groups.title: Fixed or brought across since the first check

items.text: Photos of Coade Stone Pillars: the 12-photo grid with descriptions on hover, then the 8 zoomable close-ups, as on the live desktop page (13 October).
Events: the extra "Forthcoming Events" button removed, and the greyed "Back to Events Page" button shown (13 October).
Oral History: the new intro wording, from the 14 October export.
Home: the new "Join the Portobello Heritage Trust…" paragraph, from the 14 October export. Its Membership Application Form button will appear once the forms are built.

Contact: the line "Postal address: Portobello Heritage Trust, 16 Bellfield Lane, Edinburgh, EH15 2BL" is no longer on the Contact page itself in the latest Xara version; it now appears only inside the membership form pop-up. Was that intended? (The Registered Office address is still on the home page.)

Photos of Coade Stone Pillars on the live site: the top gallery's description area includes an image whose address is the placeholder "{text}". Hover over a photo there and see whether a small broken-image icon appears.

groups.title: Effects on the live site that the replica doesn't have

items.text: Photos that fade in as you scroll down to them: Chocolate Factory, Helen Hopekirk, Heritage Trail Leaflet, Marine Gardens, Shops and Shopkeepers and Toddlers Hut. On the replica the same photos are there from the start.

not_covered: Not covered: the phone layout of the live site, and spacing or alignment that only a person looking at the page would notice. Intended differences (page titles, clickable addresses, plaque panels, payment details on Contact) are listed under each page, not as problems.

page_notes.photos-of-coade-stone-pillars: Reviewed by eye: this live page draws both galleries with scripts the automatic check can't see, so the replica's photos are listed as extra below. Checked by hand: the replica has the same 12-photo grid and 8 zoomable close-ups. The replica also shows each close-up's caption under it, where the live site shows it in the zoom.
page_notes.miss-meg-moir: Reviewed by eye: the two flagged photos (High Street looking east, and the second street view) are the same pictures on both sites; Xara re-saved them 1 pixel narrower when publishing. No action needed.
